parcel_identification: No parcel list is published in the dossier. The lot is identified by matching the applicant's 'Projet global' plan (summary page 7), which shows the northern lot bounded by rue de Lyon, by labelled parcels 899 E 6, 7, 10-16, 20, 21 and 23 to the north and north-west, by the Aygalades stream with parcels 899 E 37, 50, 63-65 and 69 beyond it, by parcels 57 and 59 to the east, and by the 'limite d'emprise du lot nord juillet 2025' to the south. In the current cadastre (prefix 899, section E of Marseille 15e) the parcels lying between rue de Lyon, the stream strip (E 71, E 84), those northern neighbours and the southern lot are E 81 (31,193 m2) and E 82 (13,104 m2): E 81 abuts E 7, E 10-12 and E 14-16, E 82 abuts E 16-21 and the stream strip, and both abut the southern lot E 74 (45,551 m2), which holds the 336 rue de Lyon address point and the Géorisques point of SAINT LOUIS SUCRE. The plan's internal numbers 53, 56 and 58 no longer exist (the July 2025 division); the SDES register lists permit PC 013 055 25 00547 of 28 April 2026 to FONCIERE SAINT LOUIS at 336 rue de Lyon on parcels H 115, E 58 and E 56 with 48,857 m2 of land.
parcel_area_note: E 81 and E 82 total 44,297 m2 by contenance against 46,807 m2 declared for the landholding (95%); the difference is not resolved (parcel H 115 of 1,000 m2, prefix 905, lies at the northern tip and the small parcels E 83-90 east of E 82 are not included).
